name: octopush
description: The IDE for Agentic Developers — eight arms, zero wasted tokens.

scripts.tauri:build: cd src-tauri && cargo build --release --bin octopush-pty-server --bin octopush-mcp --bin octopush-run-worker && cd .. && tauri build
scripts.tauri:build:universal: cd src-tauri && cargo build --release --target aarch64-apple-darwin --bin octopush-pty-server --bin octopush-mcp --bin octopush-run-worker && cargo build --release --target x86_64-apple-darwin --bin octopush-pty-server --bin octopush-mcp --bin octopush-run-worker && lipo -create -output octopush-pty-server-universal-apple-darwin target/aarch64-apple-darwin/release/octopush-pty-server target/x86_64-apple-darwin/release/octopush-pty-server && lipo -create -output octopush-mcp-universal-apple-darwin target/aarch64-apple-darwin/release/octopush-mcp target/x86_64-apple-darwin/release/octopush-mcp && mkdir -p target/universal-apple-darwin/release && cp octopush-pty-server-universal-apple-darwin target/universal-apple-darwin/release/octopush-pty-server && cp octopush-mcp-universal-apple-darwin target/universal-apple-darwin/release/octopush-mcp && lipo -create -output octopush-run-worker-universal-apple-darwin target/aarch64-apple-darwin/release/octopush-run-worker target/x86_64-apple-darwin/release/octopush-run-worker && cp octopush-run-worker-universal-apple-darwin target/universal-apple-darwin/release/octopush-run-worker && cd .. && tauri build --target universal-apple-darwin
